# Butcher / Meat Counter Assistant (m/f/d) – Zagreb-Jarun store

**Company:** FreshCart Supermarkets (FICTIONAL)
**Location:** Zagreb, Croatia (on-site, Zagreb-Jarun store)
**Employment:** Full-time, 40 h/week, permanent after a 6-month probation period

Pay: €1,250–€1,450 gross/month + €100 shift allowance & 25% Sunday bonus.
Shifts: early 06:00–14:00 or late 13:00–21:00, alternating weekly; every 2nd Saturday.

## What you'll do

- Cut, portion & package fresh meat for the service counter and self-service shelves
- Advise customers on cuts, quantities and preparation
- Keep the counter ≥ 95% stocked at peak hours; rotate stock (FIFO)
- Record temperature & hygiene checks (HACCP)

## What we ask

- Completed butcher training or ≥ 2 years at a meat counter
- HACCP knowledge
- Forklift licence is a plus (deliveries arrive on pallets)

Apply with CV & short letter to jobs@freshcart.example

candidate_text.cover_letter:
Dear Mr. Ante Perić,

I am writing to apply for the butcher position at Mesnica Kod Ante that you mentioned to me at the market last week.

I currently work at a meat stall in the Dolac market hall, where I have served customers for four years. I weigh and price orders, run the till and clean the slicers and mincer every evening. I finished my butcher training at the Food Trades School in 2015 and I want to work with whole carcasses again, not only serve at the counter.

I am reliable, I like early mornings and your regular customers already know me from the market. I can start on the first of next month.

Kind regards,
Tomislav Mesarić

company_info.company_description:
FreshCart Supermarkets is a Croatian neighbourhood supermarket chain founded in 2008 in Velika Gorica. It operates 46 stores across Zagreb, Zagreb County and Karlovac County, employing around 1,900 people. Its offer centres on fresh local food, fair prices and knowledgeable service. Many stores have staffed meat and deli counters, supported by FreshCart’s own distribution centre and cutting room; around 60% of its fresh meat comes from Croatian producers.

FreshCart’s “Ask the counter” promise emphasises honest customer advice on products, cuts and cooking. The company values reliability, hygiene, friendliness and pride in good work, and places more weight on experience than diplomas for counter roles.

Meat-counter teams typically have three to six people working across two shifts. New staff receive a two-week introduction with an experienced butcher and a paid HACCP refresher. FreshCart also supports relevant equipment training and preparation for the master craftsman exam.

Employee reviews describe friendly teams, advance shift planning and on-time pay, while noting busy Saturdays and a strong focus on hygiene records and well-stocked counters. Benefits include a meal allowance, staff discount, Christmas bonus and public transport allowance.

FreshCart is a Croatian supermarket chain founded in 2008 in Velika Gorica. It runs 46 neighbourhood supermarkets in Zagreb, Zagreb County and Karlovac County and employs about 1,900 people.

results.content:
# Working at FreshCart
*(fictional careers page – freshcart.example/careers)*

**Store teams:** each meat counter has 3 to 6 people across two shifts, led by a counter lead who reports to the store manager. New colleagues get a two-week introduction with an experienced butcher and a paid HACCP refresher.

**Training:** FreshCart pays for forklift and pallet-truck courses for store staff who handle deliveries, and supports colleagues who prepare for the master craftsman exam (majstorski ispit) with paid exam days.

**Benefits:** meal allowance, 10% staff discount, Christmas bonus, transport allowance for public transport.

**What we look for:** reliability, care for hygiene, friendliness with customers, and pride in good work. Experience matters more to us than diplomas for counter roles.

**How we hire:** a short phone call, a 30-minute meeting at the store and a trial half-day at the counter (paid).

Tomislav Mesarić
Ulica Lipa 12, 10000 Zagreb, Croatia | +385 1 555 0142 | tomislav.mesaric@example.com

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Trained butcher and meat counter professional with experience since 2015 in a family butcher shop and market meat stall. Skilled in cutting and portioning meat, advising customers, rotating stock using FIFO and recording cold-chain temperatures. Holds a vocational butcher certificate and basic HACCP food hygiene certificate.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Butcher | Mesnica Kod Ante, Zagreb | 2019–present
- Break down 2–3 beef forequarters and 10–12 pork sides per week; bone, trim and portion meat for the counter.
- Serve approximately 120 customers on a Saturday, advising on cuts and cooking times.
- Rotate cold-room stock each morning, placing the oldest stock at the front, and record cold-room and display-counter temperatures twice daily.
- Make four varieties of fresh sausage, producing approximately 40 kg per week in the busy season. Developed the shop’s lamb merguez recipe and adjusted its ćevapi mix following customer feedback; the ćevapi won second place at the Zagreb County craft meat fair in 2023.
- Prepared whole lambs and suckling pigs for weddings and family parties, including a 180-guest wedding order in 2024.
- Trained two apprentices in knife handling and cleaning routines.

Counter Assistant | Tržnica Dolac meat hall stall, Zagreb | 2015–2019
- Served customers, weighed and priced orders, and operated and balanced the till.
- Cleaned and sanitised slicers, mincers and the counter at close; wrote a closing and cleaning checklist following a hygiene inspection remark.

EDUCATION & CERTIFICATES
Vocational Certificate: Butcher, three-year programme | Food Trades School Zagreb | 2015
HACCP Basic Food Hygiene Certificate | 2021, renewed 2024

SKILLS
- Meat preparation: carcass breakdown (beef, pork and lamb), boning, trimming, portioning and paper wrapping
- Food safety: HACCP basics, cold-chain temperature checks, FIFO stock rotation, cleaning and sanitising
- Equipment: knife sharpening, mincer and bandsaw operation, hand pallet jack
- Customer service: advice on cuts and cooking times, weighing and pricing, cash handling
- Sausage making and recipe development

LANGUAGES
Croatian: Native | English: Good | German: Basic

The quantified details—approximately 120 Saturday customers, weekly carcass volumes, 40 kg of sausage, and a 180-guest order—add significant impact. The document is complete for this role and contains no apparent unsupported claims when cross-referenced with the Original Candidate Information.

It should have a high AI/ATS screening probability for this vacancy, approximately 95%, because both must-have requirements are explicit and supported. A small improvement would be to add the target role as a headline and use the job ad's exact phrase 'package fresh meat' where truthful. Do not add tray-sealer, self-service-shelf, or supermarket-equipment keywords because the candidate's material does not support them.
critique.job_alignment_feedback: Alignment is excellent. The CV clearly shows completed butcher training, nine years of relevant meat-counter experience, HACCP knowledge, customer advice on cuts and cooking times, fresh-meat preparation, FIFO stock rotation, temperature logging, cleaning and sanitising, and cash handling. It also supports FreshCart's culture signals of reliability, hygiene, friendliness, knowledgeable customer advice, and pride in good work. The candidate lacks the nice-to-have forklift licence, which is a genuine gap rather than a CV defect. The candidate's notes also indicate no supermarket experience and no tray-sealer or self-service labelling-scale experience; these are role-experience gaps, but they should not be presented as qualifications or inserted as keywords. The document appropriately does not claim them.

In the Professional Summary, revise the final sentence to: "Holds a vocational butcher certificate and a basic HACCP food hygiene certificate, with practical experience in FIFO stock rotation, cold-chain temperature logging, and cleaning and sanitising routines." This keeps the existing facts but uses the job ad's food-safety terminology more directly.

Dear Hiring Manager,

I am applying for the Butcher / Meat Counter Assistant position at FreshCart. I completed my butcher training in 2015 and have worked in a market meat stall and a family butcher shop, preparing meat and serving customers.

On a busy Saturday, I serve around 120 customers. This experience fits well with FreshCart’s “Ask the counter” promise of knowledgeable, honest advice.

Food safety is an important part of my work. I hold a basic HACCP food hygiene certificate, rotate cold-room stock each morning using FIFO and record cold-room and display-counter temperatures twice daily. At the Dolac meat hall, I cleaned and sanitised equipment and wrote a closing checklist following a hygiene inspection remark.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my butchery and customer service experience could contribute to your team. Thank you for considering my application.

Kind regards,
Tomislav Mesarić
